why.title: Here's why
why.flipFc: The flight controller was mounted backwards. It read every tilt the wrong way round, so each correction pushed the craft further over until it flipped. On a real build, turn the board so its arrow points forward, or set align_board_yaw = 180 in the CLI.
why.flipProps: The props were on the wrong motors. A prop on a motor that spins the other way blows air up, so that corner pushed down instead of lifting and the craft rolled over on take-off. Each prop goes on the motor whose spin matches its direction.
why.flipMotor: One motor spun the wrong way, because nobody checked the motor direction with the props off. Its torque fought the others and the craft flipped as soon as it lifted. On the bench, run Check motor direction and reverse the odd one out.
why.desync: The motors ran past their rating: this pack's voltage times the motors' KV spins them faster than the ESCs can follow. An ESC lost sync, the motor stuttered and the craft fell. Pick motors or a pack within the rating.
why.battery: The pack hit its cut-off voltage and the ESCs stopped the motors, so it fell. Land when LOW BATTERY shows, and never run a LiPo flat.
why.servos: The elevons moved the wrong way: a command to lift the nose pushed it down, and the wing dived into the ground. Reverse the servos in the flight controller and check them by hand before every launch.
why.tailHeavy: The centre of gravity was behind the mark, so the nose kept pitching up until the wing stalled and dropped. Move the pack forward until the wing balances on its CG mark.
why.propBackwards: The pusher prop was on backwards. It gives less than half its thrust, so the wing never reached flying speed and sank into the grass. The printed side of the prop faces forward.
why.hardLanding: It hit the ground at {speed} m/s, and the frame and props take about 3 m/s. With a manual throttle you catch the fall yourself: ease the throttle up before the ground, not after.
why.wingLanding: It touched down too fast, too steep or banked. A wing lands level, slow and into the wind: let return-to-home bring it round, or line up long and flare just above the grass.
why.hit: It flew into {what} at {kmh} km/h. Distance is hard to judge in the chase view: the FPV goggles (V) show what is ahead, and the autopilot's ghost flies a line that clears everything.

breakIt.title: Break it
breakIt.lede: Put a real build mistake in, even mid-flight, and watch what it does. A crash replays in slow motion and says why.
breakIt.noBoard: Laps flown with something broken don't go on the leaderboards.

fcReversed.label: Mount the flight controller backwards
fcReversed.what: Its arrow points at the tail, so it reads every tilt the wrong way round.

propsSwapped.label: Swap the props round
propsSwapped.what: Each prop sits on a motor that spins it the wrong way: that corner pushes down.

motorDirUnchecked.label: Skip the motor direction check
motorDirUnchecked.what: One motor spins the wrong way, and nobody looked with the props off.

accUncalibrated.label: Skip the accelerometer calibration
accUncalibrated.what: The flight controller doesn't know which way is level, so it won't arm.

overKv.label: Run the motors over their rating
overKv.what: Too many volts for these motors' KV: the ESCs lose sync at full throttle.

servosReversed.label: Reverse the servos
servosReversed.what: The control surfaces move the wrong way: up is down.

tailHeavy.label: Put the pack too far back
tailHeavy.what: The centre of gravity sits behind the mark, so the nose keeps pitching up.

propBackwards.label: Fit the prop backwards
propBackwards.what: The pusher prop gives less than half its thrust.
